cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-open-shows-today-and-preserves-modeline
cases.purpose: Opening mounts Today with date, clean borderless tabs, sidebar and preserved Emacs mode-line.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-capture-natural-language-grammar
cases.purpose: Natural-language capture parses dates, time ranges, priority, tags, area, project, estimate and note/question kinds.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-j-k-navigation-and-page-digits
cases.purpose: j/k move across visible rows and digits 1..6 always switch all six views cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-inline-capture-works-across-pages
cases.purpose: a opens inline capture and commits entries on Today, Calendar, List, Project and Habits.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-inline-edit-updates-title-and-escape-cancels
cases.purpose: e edits the selected entry title in place on RET and cancels cleanly on Escape.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-x-completes-today-and-overdue-and-persists
cases.purpose: x completes both today and overdue tasks and persists state across reopen.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-recurring-task-spawns-next-day
cases.purpose: Completing a recurring task automatically creates the next scheduled occurrence.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-smart-migrate-pull-back-and-batch-overdue
cases.purpose: m migrates today to tomorrow, pulls migrated rows back idempotently, and M batch-migrates overdue items.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-delete-drop-and-undo-restore
cases.purpose: d soft-deletes, z drops, and u / etaf-agenda-undo-last restores the prior state.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-inspector-status-priority-and-layered-escape
cases.purpose: RET opens the interactive right-rail Inspector, s/! mutate fields, and Escape closes while preserving selection.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-search-filters-live-and-escape-clears
cases.purpose: Live search filters entries across title, tags and area and Escape clears the filter.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-calendar-month-week-and-rail
cases.purpose: Calendar switches Month/Week with w, navigates months and shows both events and tasks in the right rail.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-list-grouping-and-done-state
cases.purpose: List cycles all four groupings, toggles completed visibility, and reflects true completion state.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-project-stages-and-real-progress
cases.purpose: Projects create stages, group +project tasks, and update completion progress when tasks are toggled.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-habits-checkin-and-day-navigation
cases.purpose: Habits check off via x and step across past days via h/l without inflating daily task counts.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-review-and-doctor
cases.purpose: Review displays monthly KPIs and heatmap across months and doctor reports accurate database facts.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-area-filter-scopes-today-and-list
cases.purpose: Filtering by an area via f narrows Today and List to that area and restores all entries on 全部.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-hover-discipline-across-views
cases.purpose: Hover highlights apply only to eligible interactive controls and never paint calendar cells, habit matrices, badges, active tabs or reading cards.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-lossless-undo-across-mutations
cases.purpose: u cleanly reverts batch overdue migrate, smart migrate, recurring completion and habit check-in without leaving ghost instances.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-reschedule-and-clear-date-remove-stale-day
cases.purpose: Rescheduling or clearing scheduled date removes stale open instances from the old day and u restores them cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-inline-capture-on-review-and-empty-project
cases.purpose: a opens a visible inline capture row and commits entries on both the empty Project page and the Review page.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-inspector-title-edit-recurrence-and-body-actions
cases.purpose: Inspector supports inline title editing on Calendar, exposes recurrence on regular tasks, and provides explicit Save/Cancel actions for multiline notes.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-zero-jitter-selection-and-anchored-headers
cases.purpose: Calendar mode tabs, steppers and day selection maintain exact columns with zero text jitter across Year/Month/Week modes, and Habits anchors to real today.

cases.name: etaf-agenda-tests-light-theme-contrast-and-year-summary
cases.purpose: Light themes enforce WCAG AA contrast across muted, dim and info text (avoiding washed-out yellow) and Year View renders all 12 months with annual summary and legend.
